text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day to help Biko Pegasus
with her daily "Tokusatsu UmaTok video"—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Biko-san.
The set repairs are finished."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Really?!
Show me, show me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aweeeesome! The backdrop
is totally fixed up!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad I asked you for help, Believe-senpai!
I really wanted to shoot this scene right here no matter what!
—Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I was just doing my job.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Aha! Time to pay the piper.
Give it up, Justice Biko!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Don't let your guard down, okay~? She's at her strongest when backed into a corner.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come at me, Justice Biko.
âToday will be the day you perish.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hrmmm!
It's so good! That's why it's hard to choose, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry! Grass-senpai! Heart-senpai!
Could we try shooting a take where you act more like small-time goons...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Sure!! No problem at all. I cleared
my schedule for you today anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Same here! Please let me keep trying
until I can deliver the performance Biko wants~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... thank you!
I'll definitely make it up to you!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(............
They're really particular about this, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding, dong...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
The sound of a hammer...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hrmmm...
Maybe around the decorations...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, Believe-senpai! Good evening!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Are you making
a hero belt?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's different from the one for my racing outfit!
I need it for the next shoot, you see!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...There are already so many prototypes stacked to the side.
I wonder if they've been at it for a long time...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Quite a few of them turned out well, but...
Even so, it's still not enough...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
…………Um.
It's already quite late, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. But still, I really want to be particular about this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because Carrotman, who I love so much,
is that kind of hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"You know, Carrotman's sense of justice is super
cool, but that's not all there is to him!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrot Gun, Carrot Smasher...
His gadgets are super cool too!
And, and! The Carrot Bike and stuff—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I became obsessed with him!
Carrotman is just so completely cool!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then I've gotta do it too!
I won't stop fussing over it until it looks totally cool!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I think I might understand how they feel.
I'm also...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Once I've decided to do something...
I hate doing things by halves more than anything.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Then what I should offer isn't worry. If it were me, I wouldn't want that.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case...
I won't stop you anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, are you sure it's okay!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's what Biko-san wants to stick to...
so I don't think it's my place to butt in.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Believe-senpai's trainer!
Hey, hey, take a look! Come over here~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she showed me then was an elaborately crafted
"Hero's Belt," its center adorned with
constellation motifs.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, pretty cool, right? It's finally done!
A Transformation Belt! I made it together with Believe-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'll take care of the decorations.
choice_data_list: Huh... You can really tell how much thought went into this!
Huh... You can really tell how much thought went into this!
What are you going to do with this?
What are you going to do with this?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'll take care of the decorations.
choice_data_list: Huh... You can really tell how much thought went into this!
Huh... You can really tell how much thought went into this!
What are you going to do with this?
What are you going to do with this?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm so glad, Senpai!
You totally get my creative vision!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...So you can tell, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
We're filming a hero video.
With Biko-san as the star...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, I...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Sounds awesome!
You should definitely participate too, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......
Please let me think about it for a bit.
